title: dPathHRD predicts HRD status and platinum response from ovarian cancer slides
summary: dPathHRD couples a pre-trained transformer-based pathology foundation model with attention-based multiple-instance learning to predict HRD status from H&E slides in high-grade serous ovarian cancer. AUC was 0.920 in the discovery cohort and 0.766 in the validation cohort, and HRD-like cases showed higher complete response rates and longer progression-free and recurrence-free survival across three cohorts. The authors state prospective validation is warranted.
ai_technology: Pathology foundation model with attention-based multiple-instance learning

evidence.tested: Discovery, validation and platinum-response cohorts (three cohorts in total).
evidence.unknown: Modest validation AUC; retrospective; foundation model not named in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicts HRD status and platinum response directly from slides.
